steps: Simple analgesia: paracetamol or an NSAID, used sparingly.
Address triggers — stress, poor sleep, posture, caffeine, eye strain.
Prophylaxis with low-dose amitriptyline if chronic (>15 days/month).
Avoid opioids and frequent analgesia (medication-overuse risk).

drugRefs.dose: 1 g up to four times daily (max 4 g/day)
drugRefs.freq: as needed, up to four times daily
drugRefs.why: First-line acute relief for tension-type headache; limit frequency to avoid medication-overuse headache.
